script: Pick a niche first, a group of people with a shared problem. Then find products that solve that problem for them. Start with about forty ideas. Remove weak ones at each stage: light and sturdy products first, then demand and margin checks, then a small paid test. Expect to reject most ideas. Check search trends over twelve months, read real reviews, and look at the Meta Ad Library to see which ads have run for months. Before you buy samples, do the sum. As a first screen, the selling price should be at least three times the landed cost.
glossary: dropshipping, supplier, ROAS, CPA, stop-loss, Shopify
